blocks.text: Every hit tears through shields, then armor, then hull, and every weapon has a layer it was built to break.
blocks.title: Break through, layer by layer

blocks.text: Shipyards turn out specialists, each one tuned to hunt a different kind of prey.
blocks.title: specialist variants

blocks.text: Drones, tractor beams, missile salvos, flak, rail guns: arm every fleet to fight its own way.
blocks.title: weapon Mods

blocks.text: Radiation zones, spice nebulae, ion storms and twin suns shape every battlefield.
blocks.title: Living star systems

blocks.text: Grow your people, mine your worlds to the core, and watch a drained gas giant blow.
blocks.title: Worlds worth fighting for

blocks.text: AI or NAI, it plays by your rules and sees only what its own sensors see.
blocks.title: An opponent that never cheats

blocks.text: Mine, haul, build, attack, take worlds: your worlds feed and power it all. Research shapes every strategy, and an empire left alone keeps growing.
Ships inside a spice nebula stay hidden unless an enemy comes close, and an enemy starbase stays on your map once you have seen it.
Nothing refills. Rocks, gas giants, world crusts and spice nebulae all run dry, so a long match becomes a fight over what is left.
Gas giants and mined-out worlds glow when nearly empty.
Destroy every enemy starbase and Constructor, or starve the enemy into a Terminal Blackout. Losing your worlds alone does not end the game.
